lines.en: Grandma, happy holiday! I want to bow to you.
lines.ko: 할머니, 명절 잘 보내세요! 절을 드리고 싶어요.

lines.en: Thank you. I wish you good health.
Why do we bow and say a greeting?
It's an old tradition in Korea.
Did you bow to your parents too?
Yes, I bowed to my parents every holiday long ago.
lines.ko: 네, 오래전에는 명절마다 부모님께 절을 했어요.

lines.en: Is that a feast on the table?
Yes. Our family gathers for a feast today.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘은 온 가족이 잔칫상에 모여요.

lines.en: May I eat a tangerine now?
Yes, take one. We will have our feast soon.
lines.ko: 네, 하나 가져가요. 곧 다 함께 잔칫상을 들 거예요.

dialogs.about: 명절을 앞두고 시장에서 귤과 선물을 사기

lines.en: Hello. I need tangerines for the holiday.
Hello! How many boxes do you want?
Two boxes, please. My children gather at my house.
lines.ko: 두 상자 주세요. 아이들이 우리 집에 모여요.

lines.en: Do you want a gift box for it?
Yes. Can you wrap one box for my son?
lines.ko: 네. 한 상자는 아들 줄 것으로 포장해 주실래요?

lines.en: Sure. I will wrap it with red paper.
I bought tangerines here last year too.
I remember you. It's a nice tradition.
Thank you. Will you be open tomorrow?
Yes, every day this week. Take this tangerine, please.
lines.ko: 네, 이번 주는 매일 열어요. 이 귤 하나 가져가세요.
